title: Idempotency keys, and the payment that was sent twice

videos.script:
Somebody taps Buy on a train. {{tap}} The card is charged, and the answer is lost in a tunnel. The app retries, as it should. {{twice}} And the card is charged again.

Nothing in either program is wrong on its own. The fix is a name for the operation. {{key}} The phone makes it when the person taps, before the first try, and sends it with every retry. The server remembers the answer it gave to each name. {{replay}} When the name comes back, it sends the same answer, and charges nothing.

Then what the server keeps, and for how long. {{rules}} A reused key with a different body is refused. Two tries racing get a conflict. And some operations need no key at all. {{put}} A PUT to a name the phone chose is harmless the second time.
